title: eupatorium subintegerrimum var. aliciae
intro: Eupatorium subintegerrimum var. aliciae, commonly known as Alica's Joe Pye Weed, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Alica's Joe Pye Weed are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
